en.body: The EDGE consortium meets twice a year. Our next consortium meeting will be held in-person in Lucerne on 22 and 23 August 2024. Consortium meetings are always very nice ways to exchange ideas and reflect on progress made. Our last in-person consortium meeting was held a day after the biennial conference in Bern on 23 August 2023.
